note: Soft voices built in code (doc 24, synth.js). fmPiano: a two-operator FM electric piano, made of two stacks played together. body: a sine carrier at the note's pitch modulated by a sine at ratio times the pitch; the modulation index starts at index0 (at full velocity; velocityIndex sets how much softer playing lowers it) and falls to index1 over indexDecayS seconds, which is the warm bloom of the attack fading to a round tone; level in dB. tine: the bright bell-like click of the tine, a carrier at carrierRatio and modulator at ratio, a short burst decaying over decayS. amp: attackS, then the level falls by decayDbPerS (more in the treble, by trebleDecayExtra per octave above middle C) while the key is held; releaseS when the key is let go (pedal holds it). velocity: floorDb at velocity 1 to topDb at 127 with gamma. detuneCents spreads two copies of the body a touch for warmth (0 for none). maxVoices caps polyphony per tier.
